head: codex/5861-v092-csdlc-preparation
title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2] Simplify issue preparation and binding
body:
Closes #5861

## Summary
- separates claim-free issue preparation from execution ownership
- adds immutable generations, readiness receipts, dependency and batch truth, typed migration, and crash-safe recovery
- derives binding from governed session authority and hardens retry/release worktree topology
- removes the direct init release surface and documents the new operator workflow

## Validation
- focused preparation regression suite: 20/20 passed
- strict all-target C-SDLC v2 Clippy: passed with -D warnings
- broader shared lifecycle compatibility suites were also green during implementation review
- Gemini 3.1 Pro exact-head remediation review: no actionable findings
- independent exact-head review: no actionable findings

## Review truth
- Claude identified two final cross-platform/topology defects; both are fixed in the reviewed revision
- two later Claude rerun calls returned empty provider output at HTTP 200 and are recorded as provider failures, not approvals
- publication guard accepts the subsequent review-metadata-only commit
